events.text: {"verdict":"proceed","decision":"Unblock T-493 and take it off T-489 (a). We're answering (a) ourselves: yes, a challenge gets its own seat price per currency. Build it end to end. Add a challenge seat price table (one row per currency: USD, INR, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, SGD, AED) to the D1.15 challenge seats field. Extend the close-setup job, or add a seat-setup step, so it creates a second Dodo checkout product (Stripe as the option) with by_currency localized prices that are tax-inclusive and in minor units, the same as dodo-setup.mjs. Wire the challenge page's paid button to this product instead of the close checkout. Add the entry-purchased tag on the webhook. Update the D2.19 card copy. Test only on the Dodo simulator and on our own funnel Worker or test attendees. Add probes, run them, deploy to the centre, then mark T-493 review and put the preview links in Evidence. Also record on T-489 that (a) is decided.","why":"T-489 (a) is a product choice, not something only Adi can supply (orchestrator-autonomy, build-fully-a[redacted]). D2.19 already teaches that the entry price filters harder and lists entry-purchased as missing. geo-pricing calls for one table per currency. DECISIONS_FOR_ADI B11 names this exact gap.","outward_ok":["Commit and push the T-493 build to the adisuja/3-day-tantra-ai-revops-workshop repo","Deploy the updated centre Worker and the funnel Worker to our own Cloudflare (revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev)","Create test Dodo products only in the Dodo simulator or in test mode, never in a live client vendor account"],"reassign_to_claude":true,"adi_input":null}
